name: test-studio
description: Test Studio monorepo: apps/web (Next.js + Grafana UI), packages/core (shared logic). poc-screencast คือต้นแบบเดิม ยังรันแยกต่างหาก

scripts.build: npm run build -w @test-studio/core && npm run build -w @test-studio/db && npm run build -w @test-studio/runner
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @test-studio/core && npm run typecheck -w @test-studio/db && npm run typecheck -w @test-studio/runner
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:core && npm run test:db && npm run test:runner
